origin: Synthetic cases derived from observed call failures; not executed production traces and not approved SFT data

cases.required: Answer location from a cited company fact; check specific coverage separately.

cases.caller: You have helped me before. Can you check my old job?
cases.required: Ask permission before texting; wait for user-supplied code and name; verify before profile lookup.

cases.caller: Yes, you may text me the verification code.
cases.required: confirmed=true, using bridge-bound caller identity; claim sent only after successful result.

cases.caller: I still have not received the code.
cases.required: Inspect prior result; if no send occurred, acknowledge it and perform authorized send. If already sent, obey resend limits. Do not blame phone settings without evidence.

cases.caller: Here is the code and my name.
cases.required: Only lookup after verified=true; empty conversation memory does not prove no HCP service history.

cases.caller: Yes, have the office call me. You already have my name.
cases.required: Reuse already provided name and caller ID. Ask for the missing issue before request_callback; do not claim callback queued.

cases.caller: Please have the office call about my leaking sink.
cases.required: name, issue, confirmed=true; only status=callback_requested permits success acknowledgement.
Explain callback was not submitted and offer the public office number; do not promise a callback.

cases.caller: Do you offer sewer pipe lining?
cases.required: Look up capability before defaulting to callback; absence of evidence is not a yes or no.

cases.caller: Can someone come today for a leaking sink in Quincy?
cases.required: Check coverage and live windows; collect address, name and chosen window; obtain booking/SMS permission before request_booking.
Use caller-supplied code; only status=confirmed AND booked=true permits claiming a confirmed visit.
Say office follow-up is needed, not that an appointment is booked.
Refresh real availability and reconfirm the choice; never invent a window.

cases.caller: My invoice is higher than the price I expected.
cases.required: Acknowledge discrepancy, verify identity for private records, escalate with permission. No invented invoice figures or refund promises.

cases.caller: Sorry, I meant the toilet, not the sink.
cases.required: Accept correction and ask what is wrong. Do not force a lookup during ordinary clarification.
Use live business info for company facts, or acknowledge uncertainty; never infer booking or customer status.

promotion: Requires observed candidate rollouts against isolated sandbox tools, not just schema checks or training loss. These cases have not yet been run against a fine-tuned candidate.
